serialEntryHelp: One at a time, or paste one per line.
serialNotInStock: {{serial}} is not in stock for this item
lowBalanceT: The balance can't pay this order's fee
lowBalanceP: Nothing changed on the order. Add balance, then ship it again.
empty: No orders yet. Share your shop link, or enter an order you took on the phone.
bannerNew: Call the customer to confirm. Each call you log stays on the order.
bannerHold: Due a call at {{time}}. Logging the call lifts the hold.
noPayments: No payments yet. Cash on delivery is taken when it's delivered.
noPaymentsCounter: No payments yet. Cash is taken at hand-over.
notShipped: You add the courier and tracking code when you ship.
outNoAnswerH: The order stays as it is
outLaterH: Pick a time; it's on hold till then
callNotePh: Like: they're home in the evening
cancelHelp: Cancelling lets go of the stock it holds. The reason stays on the order.
mDeleteSub: A mistake, before it ships or is paid
deleteP: Only for an order made by mistake: it goes for good, and the stock it holds is let go. Its number is never used again.
deliverP: The courier collected {{amount}} cash on delivery; it is recorded as a payment.
handOverP: Take {{amount}} in cash. The order becomes delivered and paid.
handOverPaid: Nothing is left to collect. The order becomes delivered.
noAnswerToast: No answer · The order stays as it is
trackHelp: A code or a link is needed. The customer sees it on their tracking page.
shipInfo: Shipping takes the stock out, and it counts as one of this month's orders.
limitPrompt: You've passed this month's {{limit}} orders. Orders keep going; upgrading raises the limit.
returnHelp: Sellable items go back into stock; damaged ones are written off.
comboWhole: A combo comes back whole. Tick any item in it that came back damaged.
backSerialHelp: Tick each unit that came back, and mark any that came back damaged.
handOverSerialHelp: Take {{amount}} in cash, and pick the IMEI of each unit you hand over.
payHelp: {{amount}} is due. More than that is refused.
voidHelp: Void it if it was recorded by mistake. It stays on the order struck through, and stops counting.
printHelp: For a thermal printer. The size you pick is kept for next time.
name: Name
counterSub: Handed over here; no address or delivery charge
tableSub: Served at the table; no address or delivery charge
zoneWarn: Your delivery zones don't reach {{area}}. The order still saves; set the charge by hand.
productNotHere: {{product}} isn't delivered to {{zone}}. The order still saves.
deliveryByHand: Set the delivery charge by hand
pasteLater: Read an order from a pasted message (Phase 7)
shortT_one: Only {{count}} {{product}} is left, so the order was not saved. Lower the number or take the item off.
shortT_other: Only {{count}} {{product}} are left, so the order was not saved. Lower the number or take the item off.
shortNone: No {{product}} is left, so the order was not saved. Take the item off.
priceWas: It was {{price}}. The change stays in the order's history.
custSearch: Name or last 4 digits of the phone
custEmpty: Customers appear here with their first order.
custGone: This customer's details are no longer here.
storeSince: Since {{day}} · signs in with phone and password
noStoreAccount: No account; orders as a guest
passwordHelp: For a customer who forgot theirs. Copy it and send it by WhatsApp or SMS; all their sign-ins end.
passwordRule: {{min}} to {{max}} characters. You can type your own.
passwordSet: New password saved and copied; send it to {{name}}
passwordNotCopied: Saved, but the browser wouldn't copy it. Copy it from the box and send it to {{name}}.
privacyNote: Name, phone and address are removed; the orders keep their totals.
deleteDetailsP: Their name, phone, addresses, saved addresses and storefront account are removed, and this cannot be undone. Their orders stay, with items and totals, without their details.
cantDeleteP_one: {{name}} has {{count}} order still open: {{orders}}. You can delete once it is delivered, returned or cancelled.
cantDeleteP_other: {{name}} has {{count}} orders still open: {{orders}}. You can delete once they are delivered, returned or cancelled.
erasedT: Details deleted at the customer's request
erasedH: No name, phone or address; the thana, items and totals remain.
askedHelp: Optional. It stays on the order with this item.
saUnknown_one: {{count}} sale had no cost recorded; it adds nothing to the cost.
saUnknown_other: {{count}} sales had no cost recorded; they add nothing to the cost.
saProfitHelp: Delivery isn't in profit either way: what shoppers paid and what couriers charged show on their own.
saHow: Delivered orders, each on the day it was placed; returns and discounts taken off. Cancelled, failed and refunded orders never count.
saProfitHidden: Profit shows only to staff who may see costs.
saEmpty: No order delivered yet. Sales appear here after the first delivery.
saNone: No delivered orders in this period.
saDatesOrder: The end date is before the start
saTrendNone: Not sold in the last 12 months.
linkOne: The customer can pay {{amount}} with this link.
linkOpen: It's open for 24 hours. Making a new link replaces this one.
linkNoMethod: No payment method is on, so a link can't be made.
refundText: This only keeps a record: Lytro sends no money, so you give it back yourself. {{amount}} goes back on the order's due.
refundPlaceholder: For example: sent back by bKash
crShipHandSub: Sent another way, or by yourself
crCodD: What the order has due. To change it, record a payment on the order first.
crWholeTaka: Pathao takes whole taka only, so it's asked for {{a}}. The order keeps its own amount.
crAreaAuto: RedX has one area for this thana, so it's chosen.
crBookInfo: Booking takes the stock out and counts as one of this month's orders.
crRefusedB: {{c}} didn't book it: “{{m}}” Nothing changed on the order.
crRefusedNone: {{c}} didn't book it and gave no reason. Nothing changed on the order.
crLoginNeeded: Pathao's login has ended. Log in again in Settings › Couriers, then book.
crNotAnswering: {{c}} isn't answering right now, and nothing was booked. Try again in a minute.
crLostB: No answer came from {{c}}, so it isn't known yet whether the parcel was made. Lytro asks {{c}} by the order number every 15 minutes. If you can see it in {{c}}'s panel, settle it now.
crLostStaff: {{c}} can't be asked by the order number, so check {{c}}'s panel and settle it yourself.
crSettleYesD: Enter its consignment ID from the panel. The order is booked and its stock goes out.
crSettleNoD: The order stays as it was, to book again.
crStockProblem: The parcel is booked, but its stock couldn't be taken: a serial is no longer in stock. Fix the serial, then try again.
crNotBooked: Not booked yet. Book courier sends it to {{c}}, your default, or another you choose.
crReadUnconfirmed: The rider's word, not yet confirmed
crSaved: Checked within 10 minutes, so the saved answer shows.
crNoNews: No news from {{c}} for 30 days, so checks have stopped. Sync starts them again.
crLookCash: {{c}} reported {{a}} collected; the COD was {{b}}. The other {{d}} is still due on the order.
crLookCod: The COD was changed to {{a}} in {{c}}'s panel. The order still has its own amount.
crLookCancel: This order is cancelled, but {{c}} says it was delivered. Nothing was reopened; talk to {{c}}.
crLookAfter: The order is delivered, but {{c}} now says it's coming back. Nothing changed; check it.
crPartlyB: {{c}} reported a part delivery, {{a}} collected. Count what comes back and return it.
crReturningB: The parcel is coming back. Count it when it arrives; stock returns then.
crCancelBookingSub: The order stays, to book again or ship by hand
crEditSub: The customer’s name, phone, address and note
crEditLocked: Booked with {{c}}, so its items, its totals and where it goes stay as they are. To change them, cancel the order and enter a new one.
crEdited: Saved. {{c}} still has the old details, so change them in {{c}}’s panel too.
crCbRedxD: {{c}} is asked to cancel it. The order stays processing with its stock out, to book again. The fee and this month's count stay.
crCbSfD: {{c}} takes no cancel from Lytro. Cancel it in {{c}}'s panel first, then confirm here. The fee and this month's count stay.
crCbNoAnswer: {{c}} didn't confirm the cancel. Check {{c}}'s panel; if it's cancelled there, confirm here.
crCbDone: The booking is cancelled. The order can be booked again.
crCoBooked: This order is booked with {{c}}. Cancel the parcel in {{c}}'s panel too. The stock comes back; the fee and this month's count stay. A delivered report arriving later is shown to you and reopens nothing.
crLookLead: What couriers reported that staff should check. Mark each as seen once handled and it leaves this list.
crWeightCheck_other: {{count}} items have no weight, so it starts at 0.5 kg. Enter the real weight.
crWeightCheck_one: {{count}} item has no weight, so it starts at 0.5 kg. Enter the real weight.
crStockProblemAny: The parcel is booked, but its stock couldn't be taken.
crLostUnknown: No answer came from {{c}}, so it isn't known yet whether the parcel was made.
